usage: caelestia wallpaper [-h] [-p [PATH]] [-r [DIR]] [-f FILE] [-n]
                           [-t THRESHOLD] [-N]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -p, --print [PATH]    print the scheme for a wallpaper
  -r, --random [DIR]    switch to a random wallpaper
  -f, --file FILE       the path to the wallpaper to switch to
  -n, --no-filter       do not filter by size
  -t, --threshold THRESHOLD
                        the minimum percentage of the largest monitor size the
                        image must be greater than to be selected
  -N, --no-smart        do not automatically change the scheme mode based on
                        wallpaper colour
